matches.rationale: No finding addresses the concatenation/decomposition structure of Equation (3) or its indexing inconsistencies; the single finding is entirely about the attention scaling denominator.

The finding identifies exactly the defect: attention scaling should use sqrt(d) (embedding dimension) but is inconsistently given as sqrt(N_t) (token length) elsewhere in the paper, which is the same mathematical error even though it attributes the 'original' location to the appendix rather than the main text (R2/R3 polarity/endpoint allowed).
No finding discusses Equation (13) or the missing application of matrix B to the zero vector for text cross-modal updates.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Correctly flags the sqrt(d) vs sqrt(N_t) inconsistency, matching the mechanism of GT2 even though it frames it as a main-text/appendix conflict rather than an in-text substitution.
